newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Government says Tirana airport open from Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Government says Tirana airport open from Thursday.

text.p: The Albanian government said on Tuesday that Tirana airport, closed after unrest threatened to spread to the capital last week, would reopen on Thursday.
A joint statement by several ministries and read on state television said international air companies were invited to resume services to Rinas airport from March 20.

There was no indication whether several Western airlines serving the dilapidated airport would respond to the call. Flights were halted last Thursday after rebels looted a nearby army barracks and fired weapons into the air.
The statement said a helicopter was to be stationed at the airport, 25 km (15 miles) west of the capital, and army and police units deployed to ensure safe operations.
Air traffic controllers were ordered to ensure normal operation of flights through Albanian airspace.
